name: Arnold Press
instructions: Sit on a bench holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you.
As you press up, rotate your palms outward until they face forward at the top.
Reverse the motion on the way down.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand sideways to a low cable pulley holding the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in the elbow.
Lower under control.

name: Cable Front Raise
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable, handle in hand.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower under control.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit in the machine and grip the pads with your elbows.
Raise the arms out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Set cables at head height in a cable cross. Grab the left cable with the right hand and vice versa.
Pull your hands apart and back in a wide arc.
Return under control.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Attach a rope to a high cable pulley.
Pull the rope towards your face, flaring elbows out.
Externally rotate at the top.

name: Landmine Press
instructions: Fix one end of a barbell in a corner or landmine attachment.
Hold the other end at shoulder height.
Press it up and forward in an arc.

name: Pec Deck Machine
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad, elbows on the arm pads.
Bring the pads together in front of your chest.
Slowly return to the start.

name: Cable Incline Fly
instructions: Set cables at the lowest position. Lie on an incline bench between the pulleys.
Grab both handles and bring them up and together in a wide arc.
Lower under control.

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand in the middle of a cable cross machine, cables set high.
Pull handles down and together in front of your chest.
Hold briefly then return.

name: Low to High Cable Fly
instructions: Set cables at the lowest position.
Pull them up and across your body meeting at chin height.
Lower under control.

name: High to Low Cable Fly
instructions: Set cables at the highest position.
Pull them down and together, crossing at waist height.
Return under control.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with handles at chest height.
Press forward until arms are extended.
Return under control.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower the dumbbells to chest level with elbows at 45Â°.
Press back up.

name: Incline Cable Fly
instructions: Set cables low. Lie on an incline bench.
Bring handles up and together above your chest.
Lower in a wide arc.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench with an EZ-bar held directly over your chest.
Bend at the elbows lowering the bar toward your forehead.
Extend back to the start.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
instructions: Set a low cable pulley with a single grip handle.
Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend the arm back fully, squeeze at the top.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension (Rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley. Face away from the machine.
Grip the rope overhead, elbows bent.
Extend arms forward and down, flaring the rope at the bottom.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lower behind your head by bending at the elbows.
Extend back up.

name: Single Arm Cable Tricep Extension
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high cable.
Press down, keeping the upper arm stationary.
Squeeze at the bottom.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a shoulder-width or narrower grip.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press back up, focusing on the triceps.

name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench and drape your arms over the pad holding an EZ-bar.
Curl up to the top, squeezing the biceps.
Lower fully.

name: Cable Hammer Curl
instructions: Attach a rope to a low cable pulley.
Curl the rope up with a neutral (hammer) grip.
Lower under control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging at your sides.
Curl both arms up simultaneously.
Lower fully to get a deep stretch.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench.
Let the dumbbells hang and curl up, keeping upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Lower fully.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench, lean forward, and brace your elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Curl up to the shoulder.
Lower fully.

name: Machine Curl
instructions: Sit in a curl machine with arms on the pad.
Curl up to the top.
Lower under control.

name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells.
Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Alternate sides.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
instructions: Lie face-down on a chest-supported row machine or incline bench.
Row the bar up toward your chest.
Squeeze at the top and lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Seal Row
instructions: Lie face-down on a flat bench elevated on blocks, dumbbells hanging.
Row both dumbbells up to the bench, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower fully.

name: Single Arm Cable Pulldown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high cable.
Kneel or stand and pull the handle down to hip level with one arm.
Control the return.

name: Wide Grip Cable Row
instructions: Sit at a cable row with a wide handle attachment.
Row the bar into your lower chest, keeping the torso upright.
Squeeze shoulder blades and return.

name: Band Pull Apart
instructions: Hold a resistance band in front of you at shoulder height, arms extended.
Pull the band apart by squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly.

name: Straight Arm Pulldown
instructions: Stand at a high cable with both hands on a bar.
Keeping arms straight, pull the bar down to your thighs.
Return under control.

name: Meadows Row
instructions: Stand to the side of a landmine barbell.
With a staggered stance, row the bar up to your hip.
Lower under control.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit in the machine with chest on the pad.
Row the handles back squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return under control.

name: Cable Pullover
instructions: Kneel in front of a high cable holding a rope.
Pull the rope down in an arc, keeping arms straight.
Return to the start.

name: Pendlay Row
instructions: Set a barbell on the floor. Stand over it with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge to horizontal and explosively row the bar to your lower chest.
Return the bar to the floor each rep.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a bench. Place your rear foot on it.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front heel to stand back up.

name: Hack Squat Machine
instructions: Stand on the hack squat machine platform with shoulders under the pads.
Lower until knees are at 90 degrees or deeper.
Drive back up.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold a barbell at hip height. Keep a slight bend in the knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back and lowering the bar down the legs.
Drive the hips forward to return.

name: Stiff Leg Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front. Keep legs nearly straight.
Hinge at the hips, lowering the weights along your legs.
Return by squeezing glutes and hamstrings.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in the leg curl machine with the pad on the backs of your ankles.
Curl your legs under the seat as far as possible.
Return under control.

name: Step Ups
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with dumbbells.
Step up with one foot, driving through the heel.
Step down and repeat on the other side.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in the calf raise machine with pads resting on your knees.
Push up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower for a full stretch.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at chest height.
Squat down keeping your torso upright.
Drive back up.

name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance with toes pointed out.
Grip the bar inside your legs.
Drive through your heels and lockout at the top.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench, barbell over your hips.
Drive hips up until body is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze glutes at the top and lower.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench, dumbbell on your hips.
Drive hips up until body is parallel to the floor.
Squeeze glutes at the top.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Position the barbell on the Smith machine across your upper back.
Squat down until thighs are parallel.
Drive back up.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit in the machine with ankles behind the pad.
Extend your legs to fully straighten the knee.
Lower under control.

name: Standing Leg Curl
instructions: Stand at the lying/standing curl machine.
Curl one leg up toward your glutes.
Lower under control.

name: Hip Abduction Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with pads on the outside of your thighs.
Push your legs apart as wide as possible.
Return under control.

name: Hip Adduction Machine
instructions: Sit in the machine with pads on the inside of your thighs.
Squeeze your legs together.
Return under control.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
instructions: Kneel on a pad with feet secured.
Lower your torso forward slowly by extending at the knee.
Catch yourself and push back up.

name: Cable Pull Through
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable, rope between your legs.
Hinge at the hips letting the cable pull your hips back.
Drive hips forward to stand.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Drive through the front heel and step forward with the other foot.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the platform with your shoulders under the pads.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower for a full stretch.

name: Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Bend at the hips and place your forearms on a support.
Rise up on your toes.
Lower for a full stretch.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel on the floor with the ab wheel in front of you.
Roll forward until your body is nearly parallel to the floor.
Use your core to roll back.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar.
Raise your legs until they are parallel to the floor or higher.
Lower under control.

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Set cable at one side. Grip the handle with both hands.
Rotate from the hips, pulling diagonally across your body.
Return under control.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms above shoulders, hips and knees at 90Â°.
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.

name: Decline Sit Up
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with feet secured.
Sit up, touching your elbows to your knees at the top.
Lower under control.

name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in and rotate the opposite elbow to meet it.
Alternate sides in a pedaling motion.

name: Dragon Flag
instructions: Lie on a bench, gripping the top edge behind you.
Keep your body straight and raise it up until nearly vertical.
Lower slowly, keeping the body rigid.

name: Pallof Press
instructions: Stand sideways to a cable set at chest height.
Hold the handle at your chest, then press straight out.
Resist rotation throughout.

name: L-Sit
instructions: Support your weight on parallel bars or the floor.
Raise your legs until parallel to the ground.
Hold for time.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side, propped up on your forearm.
Raise your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for time.

name: Dumbbell Flat Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press up until arms are extended.
Lower under control.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench at about 30â€“45Â°.
Unrack and lower the bar to your upper chest.
Press back up.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench, feet secured.
Lower the bar to your lower chest.
Press back up.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie across a bench with a dumbbell held overhead.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head in an arc.
Pull back to the starting position.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead until arms are extended.
Lower under control.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit in a shoulder press machine.
Press the handles overhead.
Lower under control.

name: Behind the Neck Press
instructions: Sit with a barbell across your upper traps.
Press overhead, lowering behind the head.
Return under control.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of you.
Raise both to shoulder height.
Lower under control.

name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold a barbell with a close grip in front of you.
Pull it up to chin height, flaring elbows out.
Lower under control.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Stand with barbell across upper traps.
Squat down until thighs are parallel or below.
Drive back up through your heels.

name: Front Squat
instructions: Hold the barbell in a front rack position.
Squat down keeping torso upright.
Drive back up.

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Stand over the bar, feet hip-width.
Grip the bar, flatten your back.
Drive through the floor, locking out at the top.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells.
Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push back to starting position.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine and place feet hip-width on the platform.
Lower the platform by bending knees.
Press back up without locking knees.

name: Pull Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder width.
Pull your chest up to the bar.
Lower under control.

name: Chin Up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your chin above the bar.
Lower under control.

name: Weighted Pull Up
instructions: Attach a weight belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Perform a pull-up with the added weight.

name: Dip
instructions: Grip parallel bars with arms extended.
Lower by bending the elbows until upper arms are parallel.
Press back up.

name: Inverted Row
instructions: Set a bar at hip height. Hang below it with straight arms.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Place hands on a bench behind you, feet out in front.
Lower until elbows are at 90Â°.
Press back up.

name: Push Up
instructions: Place hands wider than shoulder width.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.

name: Pike Push Up
instructions: Start in a downward-dog position with hips high.
Bend elbows, lowering your head toward the floor.
Press back up.

name: Handstand Push Up
instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Lower your head toward the floor by bending the elbows.
Press back up.

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with underhand grip.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders.
Lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with neutral grip.
Curl both up simultaneously.
Lower under control.

name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Hold a barbell with overhand grip.
Curl it up while keeping wrists neutral.
Lower under control.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Hold a barbell at shoulder height in front.
Press overhead until arms are fully extended.
Lower to the front.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand or sit holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press overhead.
Lower under control.

name: Shrugs
instructions: Hold dumbbells or a barbell at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up as high as possible.
Lower and repeat.

name: Barbell Shrug
instructions: Hold a barbell in front with shoulder-width grip.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Hold briefly and lower.

name: Plank
instructions: Prop yourself up on forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heel.
Hold for time.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, leaning back slightly.
Rotate your torso side to side.
Add a weight or medicine ball for resistance.

name: Toes to Bar
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Raise your toes up to touch the bar.
Lower under control.

name: V-Up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously raise your legs and torso, reaching for your toes.
Lower and repeat.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at a low cable row with a V-bar handle.
Row the bar into your lower chest, keeping your back straight.
Return under control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a cable pulldown, gripping the bar wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Return under control.

name: Close Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use a close or neutral grip attachment on the pulldown machine.
Pull down to your collarbone.
Return under control.

name: One Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace one hand and knee on a bench.
Row a dumbbell up with the other arm.
Lower and repeat.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge forward to about 45Â°, grip barbell shoulder-width.
Row to your lower chest.
Lower under control.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Attach a bar or rope to a high cable.
Keep upper arms at your sides and push down.
Return under control.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a low cable behind you.
Extend arms overhead from behind.
Return under control.

name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with feet together.
Jump feet wide while raising arms overhead.
Return and repeat.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop to a squat and place hands on the floor.
Jump feet back to a plank position.
Do a push-up, jump feet to hands, then jump up.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a plank position.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch rapidly.

name: Box Jump
instructions: Stand in front of a box.
Explode up, landing softly on top.
Step down and repeat.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Hold the rope handles at your sides.
Swing the rope over your head and jump as it passes under your feet.

name: Rowing Machine
instructions: Sit on the rowing machine, feet secured.
Drive back with the legs, lean back, then pull the handle to your chest.
Reverse the motion.

name: Treadmill Running
instructions: Set the treadmill to a comfortable running pace.
Maintain an upright posture and steady stride.
Adjust speed and incline as needed.

name: Treadmill Walking
instructions: Set the treadmill to a brisk walking pace.
Maintain an upright posture with a natural arm swing.
Adjust speed and incline as needed.

name: Jogging
instructions: Maintain a relaxed, steady running pace.
Land lightly and keep your breathing controlled.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Adjust the seat height and resistance.
Pedal at a steady pace, keeping your core engaged.

name: Outdoor Cycling
instructions: Maintain a steady cadence and posture.
Shift gears as needed for terrain.

name: Elliptical Trainer
instructions: Step onto the pedals and grip the handles.
Move in a smooth elliptical motion, pushing and pulling with arms and legs.

name: Stair Climber
instructions: Step onto the machine and hold the side rails lightly.
Step at a steady pace, keeping your posture upright.

name: Sprints
instructions: Run at maximum effort for a short distance.
Recover with a walk or light jog, then repeat.
